package.name: replay
package.description: Plays a prepared clip directory (clips/safe/<clip>/, written offline by tools/prepare_clip.py and audited in MuJoCo) on the rig: replay_publisher reads arm_q.npz, hand_q20.npz and clip.json and publishes, on one timer, named arm joint targets to g1_world_output (mode joint_replay) and named hand joints to the starport_wuji_hand drivers, once, then holds the last frame. It refuses a directory not filed under clips/safe/, a verdict that is not safe, and a speed the audit did not pass. replay_check waits for state from the selected device nodes and prints the topic rates before a run. Pure rclpy and numpy; no device SDK, no retargeting, no run-time checks.
